scope: Independent read-only exact engineering contract review, not implementation or user-policy approval.

checks.calendar_input: Verified exact1294-byte TZif2 member/archive hashes; supported range and cutoff roundtrip/strict equality semantics are explicit. No date vectors were generated.
checks.canonical_bytes: Domain-separated preimages, display-order raw hashes, canonical ordered DTOs, exact types/nullable exceptions, bounded counts/depth and command-specific field use are defined.
checks.source_and_commit: Concrete borrowed source only; <=5 serial proofs; expected roster revision and assignment fences held through original account lease/stable mutex callback; final entry clock/cutoff check after preparation work.
checks.clock_replay: Authenticated failure observations persist clock/closure; already committed or prepared replay retains original bytes/time; new-view pending can be queried/abandoned but never applied.
checks.response_correlation: Every nonblank metadata response carries current full view and derived Entry StoreID; historical intent author stays historical; native requires established full Stable pin; Pending is the only nullable Operation response.
checks.lane_and_cache: Global active1/queued1 with explicit family routing; old wire shapes remain closed; capacity reserved before ACK and failed publication fenced; all existing cache paths charge entry bytes.
checks.installation: Explicit v3 route, separately bounded16KiB new marker, old8KiB routes preserved; all reader/writer paths and second-fixture/stable-prepared recovery are listed; logical validation permits DB lock/log maintenance without source/history rewrite.
checks.caps: Conservative arithmetic reviewed: Operation32256<32768, Check+envelope64000<131072, v3 marker explicit16KiB, logical journal ceiling below136MiB; these are source-shape bounds, not generated vectors.
checks.authorization: EntryManage requires enrolled current login; mining tokens rejected; D72 enumerated holds unchanged; old original sessions cannot mutate.
checks.deferred_policy: No locked-card, entropy, reservation, post-lock roster/retirement choice, awards, official ownership or official history API is introduced.

limitations: Root must explicitly freeze the reviewed contract and input pins before runtime/oracle work.
No new oracle, expected IDs/date outputs, source implementation, simulations, tests, live network or production resources were created or run.
Review does not approve post-lock player rights, entropy/finality/outage promises, official publication or product release; D74 and other stated gates remain.
